Do NOT use realistic foliage, photographic textures, thousands of brushstrokes, rendered lighting, anime scenery, scenic oil painting or 3D. Keep it clearly simple DRAWN narrative-game scenery at the exact graphical detail level of image1. Warm beautiful summer daylight instead of dark mysterious brown: muted cream, faded peach, dusty teal and turquoise blue ocean, muted olive, lavender shadows. 16:9 composition in 1600x900. Scene is the backing plate for a seaside post office courtyard. The main post office will be inserted later: do NOT paint the central building, and keep x570-1240,y100-730 clear of buildings or objects. RIGHT extreme x1380-1600 a short garden wall and lemon branches. Sea has a simple distant headland on the left and a few drawn white horizontal ripples. Warm broad stone courtyard starts y680; ground x150-1450,y710-815 is a clear continuous traversable horizontal lane. Ground flagstones drawn as large irregular shapes with limited interior details; believable square perspective. A little low lavender foliage at bottom corners only below830. The palette must harmonize with an unseen flat pastel lavender-and-teal post office, no saturated neon or vivid bright blue. NO humans, no UI, no lettering, no extra main building. Original art, consistent hand-drawn contours across ALL scenery; less detail, stronger design.
